description: This file defines React components for a Command Palette UI, using the cmdk library for command management and lucide-react for icons. It includes components such as Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, and others, to compose a command interface with dialog functionality and styling support.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: A wrapper around the cmdk Command component, adding styling and forwarding props.

methods.name: CommandDialog
methods.description: A dialog component that encapsulates the command palette with a header, description, and content area.

methods.name: CommandInput
methods.description: An input component with a search icon, used to filter commands.

methods.name: CommandList
methods.description: A list wrapper for command items with scrolling support.

methods.name: CommandEmpty
methods.description: Displays a message when no command results are available.

methods.name: CommandGroup
methods.description: A grouping container for command items, with heading styling.

methods.name: CommandItem
methods.description: An individual command item that can be selected.

methods.name: CommandShortcut
methods.description: Displays a shortcut key hint for command items.

methods.name: CommandSeparator
methods.description: A visual separator between command groups or items.
